text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Intermittent fasting produces weight loss.","cited_pids":[]},{"cid":"c2","text":"A meta-analysis of randomized trials found comparable weight loss and metabolic improvements between intermittent and continuous energy restriction.","cited_pids":["e5aee0e45fc5#2","e5aee0e45fc5#1"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A Harvard Nutrition Source review found no significant difference in weight loss or body composition between intermittent fasting and continuous calorie restriction.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#6"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Dropout rates were not lower for intermittent fasting than for continuous calorie restriction.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#6"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Small trials report effective weight loss with intermittent fasting combined with calorie restriction or exercise.","cited_pids":["23334c40ad6b#0","a91c1c458e6b#0","c74e11d8769a#0"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Longer-term data on intermittent fasting are limited.","cited_pids":[]},{"cid":"c7","text":"One 12-month report found that weight loss was maintained with intermittent fasting.","cited_pids":["1ab8c5bc12c2#0"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Intermittent fasting is roughly equivalent to standard calorie restriction for weight loss.","cited_pids":["e5aee0e45fc5#2"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Long-term trials of intermittent fasting are still needed.","cited_pids":["e5aee0e45fc5#2"]}]}
